execution.mechanism: klt sim --backend batch (2am EDA batch fleet, Spot)
execution.timing_note: elapsed_s per corner is the remote engine wall clock reported by klt (runtime_s). job_elapsed_s is the fleet harness's own job time. queue_provision_and_transfer_s = submit-to-collect wall minus job_elapsed_s (S3 upload, Spot acquisition/boot, polling granularity, download).

experiment.claim: README.md 'Target specification' (DR-005, amended by DR-006) row 'PSRR' (> 60 dB DC-1 kHz target; > 30 dB @ 1 MHz stretch, out of scope for wave 1 per DR-001), for the 3.3 V primary flavor. Measures the AC supply-to-VREF transfer function (1 V AC magnitude on the supply, PSRR = -db(v(vref))) of the ROUTED, LVS-clean bandgap-core layout (issue #62) -- now including the drawn VDD/VSS routing's own series R/C parasitics directly in the signal path under test -- open-circuit at VREF, over the full 45-point PVT matrix, via klt extract --parasitics translated to a simulatable netlist (sim/bin/post_layout_common.py) -- NOT design/bandgap_core.sch directly; see 'Netlist provenance' below.
experiment.provenance_source: layout/bandgap-core/reports/20260923-070209-dbd57a9/bandgap_core_routed.gds via `klt extract --parasitics` (layout record 20260923-070209-dbd57a9), translated by sim/bin/post_layout_common.py, wrapped over the unmodified sim/psrr-dc/testbench/tb_vref_psrr.sch
experiment.title: Power-supply rejection ratio, DC-1 kHz band + 1 MHz spot, untrimmed core -- POST-LAYOUT (extracted netlist)

spread_checks.note: DC rejection must move by at least 0.5 dB across the 45-point matrix. A dead-flat result would mean the corner/temperature/supply knobs are not reaching the simulator.
